profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a strong track record in developing micro-frontend applications, managing CI/CD pipelines, and crafting pixel perfect UI. Proficient in technologies such as TypeScript, React, GraphQL, and Apollo Federation. 

A problem solver with a passion for delivering high-quality software, while continuously improving processes and tools. A recent addition to Rivian Automotive, previously delivered numerous e-commerce platform features and a full-stack web application at Verizon Media (a.k.a. Yahoo!) and Vivalink. 

Holds a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from California State University, Monterey Bay.

projects.title: Cardiac Scout (iOS) - EKG and Heart Rate Monitor
projects.description: Heart monitoring app for iOS that displays current heart rate and a live EKG feed onto screen by connecting with and receiving data from proprietary Bluetooth devices. (Objective C, Swift)

projects.title: Vital Scout (iOS) - Wellness Monitor
projects.description: Wellness monitoring app for iOS that integrates directly with proprietary Bluetooth devices and displays wellness data onto screen. (Objective C, Swift)
